allOf.description: Inherits shared step-base properties ($schema, id, owner, created_at, canonical_refs_used).

tech_stack.description: Technology stack for the roadmap, at minimum specifying languages and frameworks.

allOf.description: Inherits the structured technology stack definition from core collections.

tech_stack_ref.description: Canonical reference for the technology stack in the registry.

milestones.description: Ordered roadmap milestones with user stories, tasks, and deliverables.

milestone_id.description: Unique kebab-case identifier for this milestone.

target_date.description: Planned completion date for this milestone (ISO 8601 date).

status.description: Current progress status of the milestone.

risk_status.description: Risk level associated with this milestone.

user_story.description: The specific user story this milestone addresses.

source_milestones.description: Upstream Step 09 milestone IDs this roadmap milestone maps to.

items.description: An FR ID in the format 'fr-<slug>' referencing a functional requirement.

fr_refs.description: Functional requirement IDs this milestone delivers. Each value must match a `fr_id` in the FR list (Step 04).

items.description: A capability ID in the format 'cap-<slug>' referencing a capability.

capability_refs.description: Capability IDs from spec/01_capabilities.json that this milestone implements.

task_id.description: Unique kebab-case identifier for this task.

description.description: Description of the task (must contain at least two words).

acceptance_criteria.description: Criteria that must be met for this task to be considered complete.

criterion_id.description: Unique kebab-case identifier for this acceptance criterion.

text.description: Full text of the acceptance criterion (minimum 15 characters).

fixture_ref.description: Reference to a fixture that validates this criterion.

items.description: A single acceptance criterion with ID, text, and optional fixture reference.

status.description: Current progress status of the task.

status_ref.description: Canonical reference for the status value in the registry.

environment_ref.description: Canonical reference for the target environment of this task.

metric_ref.description: Canonical reference for the metric used to measure task completion.

items.description: A task_id that this task depends on within the same milestone.

depends_on.description: task_ids this task depends on (within same milestone). Must not create cycles.

items.description: An assumption that must hold for this task to succeed (minimum 10 characters).

assumptions.description: Assumptions that must hold for this task to succeed.

items.description: A condition that definitively marks this task complete (minimum 15 characters).

exit_conditions.description: Conditions that definitively mark this task complete.

fr_refs.description: Functional requirement IDs this task addresses. Enables pairwise completeness checks.

items.description: An FR ID in the format 'fr-<slug>' referencing a functional requirement.
A single task within a milestone, with acceptance criteria and dependencies.

tasks.description: Atomic sub-tasks required to complete the user story.

deliverables.description: Trace references to artifacts this milestone will produce.

items.description: A trace reference to an artifact this milestone will produce.

risks.description: Known risks that could delay or block this milestone.

spikes.description: Technical spikes or investigations required before work can proceed.

status_ref.description: Canonical reference for the milestone status in the registry.

items.description: A single roadmap milestone with user story, tasks, and deliverables.

migration_plan.description: High-level strategy for migrating from existing systems or data.

dependencies.description: External or internal dependencies required by the roadmap.

dependency_ref.description: Canonical reference for the dependency list in the registry.

trace.description: Traceability links connecting this roadmap to related artifacts.

items.description: A traceability reference for the roadmap.
